description:
Use "observation" as the umbrella word, to match docs/00-glossary.md. Mostly naming and docs; no design talk unless the stored data changes.

Glossary: an observation is anything that arrives about a run: reporter reports, telemetry, GitHub webhooks and polls. Today the code splits these into core.Report (a reporter report), core.Event (one entry in a run's history, from a report or a status change) and the telemetry path (internal/core/telemetry.go). The report URL already says /observations (docs/20-routes.md); docs/10-design.md calls it a leftover name.

Work: decide with a short proposal to Matt whether Report and Event keep their names as kinds of observation, or get renamed. Then update docs/10-design.md (and remove the "leftover name" note in Limits) and any dashboard wording.

Keep URLs, JSON keys and the events table name for backwards compatibility.
title: Use Observation as the umbrella word for reports, telemetry and webhooks
